articles.title: Kansas City Current advances to NWSL Championship after defeating Gotham FC 2-1
articles.summary: The Kansas City Current secured a spot in the NWSL Championship by beating Gotham FC 2-1 in the semifinals, adapting well to the unusual conditions at Icahn Stadium.
articles.content: The Kansas City Current's gritty performance earned them a spot in the NWSL Championship after securing a 2-1 win over Gotham FC in the semifinals at Icahn Stadium. The venue, sandwiched between Manhattan and Queens on Randall's Island, posed unusual logistical challenges for both teams. However, it was the Current who adapted best to the conditions, producing a top-notch match despite the quirks of the stadium. The game got off to an exciting start with Kansas City's Croix Bethune scoring in the 20th minute from a free kick, her looping shot showcasing exceptional technique and precision. Bethune credited her extensive practice on set pieces for the goal, stating I've been working on free kicks all year...and a lot more leading into the playoffs so just practice makes perfect. This statement highlighted the Current's shrewd decision to sign her last winter. The unusual setting of Icahn Stadium seemed to amplify the game's intensity and physicality. The teams battled against strong winds, with Gotham facing an added challenge due to the setting sun in the first half. Despite these conditions, Bethune's impressive strike stood out as a rare on-field spectacle at Randall's Island. Kansas City's Haley Hopkins acknowledged that the Current had anticipated a tough game against Gotham, one of the league's top teams. To counter this, they employed a disciplined approach to structure and transition play. Hopkins noted, We knew it was going to be a physical game, without a doubt...so we had to be super disciplined in our structure. This strategy allowed the Current to capitalize on their opportunities. Gotham FC brought Rose Lavelle into the game, who has been dealing with fitness issues in recent weeks. However, this introduction did not alter the overall tempo of the match, which remained characterized by a high level of physicality and an emphasis on transition play. The NWSL Shield winners struggled to create scoring chances, managing zero shots on target and 0.66 expected goals over 180 minutes. The Current's approach seemed designed to exploit Gotham's vulnerabilities in transition play. Despite lacking the possession and control often associated with their style of play, they were able to capitalize on moments of uncertainty from their opponents. This strategy ultimately paid off, as Kansas City secured a crucial win. Gotham FC has been plagued by issues related to logistics and timing throughout this season. In Sunday's match, these problems reared their head once again, hindering the team's ability to mount an effective attack. The introduction of Sam Kerr did little to alleviate these concerns, with her struggling to make an impact on the game. Despite their possession dominance, Gotham FC failed to create meaningful scoring opportunities against the Kansas City Current. Their star players, including Kerr, struggled to make a significant contribution to the match. This lack of cohesion and creativity ultimately cost them dearly in their bid for a championship spot. The match at Icahn Stadium offered a compelling contrast between two teams with distinct styles of play. The Kansas City Current's grit and determination earned them a well-deserved win, while Gotham FC's logistics problems continued to plague them throughout the game. As the teams left the field, it was clear that the outcome would have significant implications for both sides in their pursuit of the NWSL Championship title. The Kansas City Current's semifinal matchup against Gotham FC was a closely contested battle that ultimately came down to the wire. Savannah McCaskill, a midfielder for the Current, reflected on their performance, stating "I think we were kind of our own worst enemy today." McCaskill acknowledged that at times they played into Gotham's style of play, which emphasized physicality and long balls. This approach was in stark contrast to the Current's preferred method of keeping possession and controlling tempo. Gotham FC had been favored to win another title, having entered the playoffs as the top team in the league with a strong regular season performance. Their postseason run had been marked by an unusual reliance on own goals, which they scored twice in their previous matches. The Current's own goal that allowed Gotham to equalize was a turning point in the game, as it shifted the momentum in favor of the underdog team. Gotham goalkeeper Ann-Katrin Berger played a crucial role in keeping her team in the match with two key blocks. Meanwhile, defender Tierna Davidson worked tirelessly to prevent the Current from scoring. The conditions at the stadium, which was reduced in size due to logistical issues, added an extra layer of difficulty for both teams. The cold and dark environment seemed to favor neither side, setting the stage for a dramatic finish. As the game entered its final minutes, it became clear that the outcome would be decided by a single moment of brilliance or a crucial mistake. The Current had done their part to create scoring opportunities, but Gotham's determination and Berger's heroics kept them in contention until the very end. The Kansas City Current's Haley Hopkins sealed their spot in next week's NWSL Championship with a crucial goal off a set piece in the 89th minute. A free kick from an undetermined source led to Hopkins' shot hitting the crossbar, ultimately securing the win for the Current. Hopkins' clutch performance came after a well-executed gameplan by the team, which earned them their spot in the championship despite losing twice to Gotham in three previous meetings this season. The Current's determination was evident as they capitalized on scoring opportunities and thwarted Gotham's attacks. Current head coach Chris Armas emphasized the importance of analyzing past games against Gotham, taking note of the ways they challenged his team. By studying these moments, the Current devised a plan that would limit Gotham's progress and force turnovers, effectively turning the game into a chess match. The Current demonstrated exceptional commitment to their strategy, which focused on controlling the middle of the pitch and pressuring Gotham in high-intensity moments. This approach allowed them to neutralize Gotham's attacks and create scoring opportunities for themselves. Bethune's star quality shone brightly on Sunday as she contributed significantly to her team's efforts. The Current's overall performance was impressive, with a formidable record featuring two-time NWSL MVP Temwa Chawinga and U.S. women's national team standout Michelle Cooper. Their seven-game winning streak en route to the championship is a testament to their growing strength and determination. The Current's victory over Gotham marked an important milestone in their season, as they now look forward to facing off against other top teams in the league. The Current's ability to adapt and adjust their strategy based on past performances proved crucial in their win. By analyzing their weaknesses and strengths, they were able to develop a gameplan that would give them the best chance of success. Gotham's logistics problems continued to plague them as they struggled to keep up with the Current's pace and determination. Despite Berger's heroics, Gotham ultimately fell short of securing a spot in the championship, leaving them to regroup and refocus for their next challenge. Gotham's success has raised the bar for teams across the NWSL, forcing opponents to come up with a solid game plan to counter their unique style of play. The team's strong defensive structure has been a key factor in their consistent performance this season. Head coach Juan Carlos Amoros has instilled an aggressive approach to defending that has earned them top spot in the league for defensive prowess. However, despite their impressive defense, Gotham's offense has struggled to find consistency. They have ranked near the bottom of the league in expected goals and goal-scoring, often relying on individual brilliance from players like USWNT stars Lavelle and Jaedyn Shaw. The team's attacking composition is an area that Amoros admits deserves further review. He acknowledges that they need to create more chances and score more goals if they want to be a true championship contender. One of the main issues has been Gotham's inability to finish their chances, with 39 goals scored in the regular season putting them at the lower end of the league in this category. Amoros is not sounding alarm bells just yet, but it's clear that he recognizes the need for improvement in this area. The team will be looking to regroup and refocus during the offseason to address their attacking woes. The coach believes that Gotham has a good foundation for creating chances, but they need to work on making better decisions in key moments of the game. Ultimately, Gotham's success is built around their strong defense, which Amoros says is something they can build on. The Kansas City Current earned their spot in the NWSL Championship through sheer determination and grit. Their opponents, however, faced logistical challenges that threatened to undermine their chances of success. Gotham's situation was particularly precarious, having been forced to play at Icahn Stadium due to issues with their usual venue, Sports Illustrated Stadium. The latter had become a home away from home for the team over the years, offering state-of-the-art facilities and a capacity crowd of 20,000 fans. Icahn Stadium, on the other hand, has its own unique charm and character, often described as a quintessential American soccer experience. However, it is not without its quirks, which only added to Gotham's woes. The pitch at Sports Illustrated Stadium had fallen into disrepair, making it impossible for the team to use their usual venue. The primary tenants' end-of-season friendly scheduled for the night before left no time for repairs, leaving Gotham with little choice but to adapt to Icahn Stadium. Winger Midge Purce was blunt in her assessment of the situation, stating that "the field is never an excuse" for losing a match. While acknowledging that the field at Randall's Island was better suited for the occasion, she emphasized that it had no bearing on their performance. Purce also expressed frustration with the lack of professionalism displayed by the league in this instance. In her opinion, it was "inexcusable" to have teams playing on a field that was not soccer-specific, particularly when there were better options available. The Current's success story is a stark contrast to Gotham's struggles, but their grit and determination earned them a spot in the championship game. Meanwhile, the NWSL's efforts to make the most of difficult circumstances continued with the semifinal match between the Washington Spirit and the Utah Royals. The Spirit's victory at Audi Field set up a thrilling finale for the league, while also highlighting the logistical challenges that teams faced throughout the season. The NWSL Championship is likely to be a closely contested affair, with both teams vying for top honors. In the build-up to the championship game, questions are being raised about the playability of the field at Audi Field. The faint football lines visible on the pitch may pose some challenges for the players, but it remains to be seen how this will affect their performance. The Kansas City Current's determination has paid off as they secured a spot in the NWSL Championship. Amoros praised the decision to switch stadiums, citing concerns over the pitch quality at Sports Illustrated Stadium, which he believed would have hindered the team's performance. The current state of the field, while imperfect, is considered more suitable for play. Amoros acknowledged that injuries had been a concern in recent games, but fortunately none were season-ending. The weekend has been marked by disappointment and frustration, particularly with regards to logistics issues affecting both teams. Yesterday's game was marred by American football lines visible on the pitch, which Amoros felt detracted from the quality of play. Despite these challenges, the club and fans have shown remarkable resilience and dedication. CBS Sports : https://www.cbssports.com/soccer/news/kansas-city-currents-gotham-fc-nwsl-semifinals-2026/

articles.title: Apple Unveils New Study on Conversational Health AI Tools
articles.summary: Apple has unveiled a new study aimed at understanding how people interact with conversational health AI tools, building on its existing Research app launched in 2019.
articles.content: Apple has unveiled a new study aimed at understanding how people interact with conversational health AI tools, building on its existing Research app launched in 2019. The Apple Health AI Study is designed to investigate comprehension, response quality, and the drivers of user trust when using AI for everyday health actions, as well as how these interactions can inform responsible design of health experiences. A major focus of the study will be examining whether users understand the information provided by health AI tools, whether they trust them, and if they are helpful in preparing for doctor's visits. The study comes at a time when one in three US adults use AI chatbots to gather health information. This collaboration highlights Apple's commitment to partnering with medical universities and institutions to run studies on various health areas, including hearing, heart health, movement, women's health, and now the intersection of health and AI. The new app, designed specifically for this study, will collect data that may inform Apple's feature development, but it will not be used to train AI models. The study is also collaborating with OpenEvidence, an AI platform designed for doctors, which generates answers using medical information from reputable sources such as the New England Journal of Medicine and the Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews. The Apple Health AI Study aims to provide insights that can help both Apple and the industry design more effective health experiences. The study app allows users to pose text-based health queries to the AI, which then provides answers accompanied by relevant clinical citations. Participants can also opt to share their HealthKit data, encompassing sleep patterns, lab results, activity levels, and resting heart rates, for more tailored responses from the AI. HealthKit serves as Apple's central repository for collecting fitness and health-related data on iPhones and Apple Watches. To join the study, users must be at least 21 years old, reside in the US, and possess an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone running iOS 26 or later, which is necessary to support the processing requirements of the study app. The study itself requires a commitment from participants for up to 12 months, during which time they can pose questions on various health topics, including general wellness, specific symptoms, recovery from procedures, and their own uploaded health data. Participants are required to check in regularly using the app, which sends notifications on their paired Apple Watch with suggested topics for exploration. If participants fail to engage with the study, they risk being removed from it altogether. This underscores the importance of regular participation and interaction with the app throughout its duration. Before joining the study, participants must complete an onboarding process that includes informed consent, as well as sharing demographic information such as age, education level, and race. This data will be used to analyze how these factors influence preferences and communication needs. Once enrolled, participants can start asking questions through the app, which are first processed by the iPhone using tools designed to remove identifiable details. The queries then move to a secure cloud-based study environment managed by UST Global, where they are screened for any remaining personal information. The data is eventually sent to OpenEvidence, where answers are generated based on reference materials. According to protocol, both question and response data will be deleted within 24 hours of processing. Participants using the Apple Health AI Study app can rest assured that their safety is a top priority. The app includes built-in safety measures to detect and address potentially concerning questions about self-harm, which are promptly flagged for review. If a participant asks a question related to self-harm, they will be directed to reach out to a healthcare provider or access additional resources, with no further contact from study staff. This approach prioritizes participant well-being and maintains confidentiality throughout the research process. To maintain data security, participants can choose whether to share their clinical health records through the app, which must first be uploaded to Apple's Health app before being shared with the new study app. CNET : https://www.cnet.com/health/apple-launches-ai-health-app-study/

articles.title: Stability of Low-Mass Stars Observed to Vary Over Time
articles.summary: Astronomers have discovered that low-mass stars like our sun undergo changes in their luminosity as they age.
articles.content: The stability of stars has long been a cornerstone of astronomy, with most appearing steady and predictable from our vantage point on Earth. This is particularly true for low-mass stars like our sun, which shine steadily for billions of years without much fanfare. Using powerful telescopes, astronomers can bring millions of stars into view, allowing them to observe and study the changes that occur in their luminosity over time. By monitoring these changes, scientists have gained valuable insights into the long-term behavior of stars across various types and ages. As low-mass stars like our sun exhaust their hydrogen fuel supplies, they undergo a transformation known as the red giant branch (RGB) phase. This is not just a theoretical concept but rather an observational conclusion supported by numerous studies of RGB stars in our galaxy. One characteristic of RGB stars is that they swell in size and become more luminous as they age and cool. However, astronomers have observed a peculiar phenomenon - a brief and abrupt dip in the brightness of these stars known as the RGB luminosity bump. The RGB luminosity bump appears as a distinctive feature in the color-magnitude diagrams used to study stellar clusters. This particular pattern has been noted in various studies of RGB stars, sparking interest among scientists seeking to understand its causes. Astronomers have identified several bright and easily observable RGB stars that can be studied further, including Arcturus, Aldebaran, and Pollux - all familiar naked-eye targets in our night sky. However, these stars still hold secrets about the mysterious RGB luminosity bump, which remains a topic of ongoing research. The mystery of the luminosity bump in aging stars has long been a topic of interest for astrophysicists. While the end of this phenomenon is well understood, its initiation remains an enigma that researchers are keen to solve. A recent study published in The Astrophysical Journal Letters sheds new light on the onset of the luminosity bump. Titled "The Role of Specific Entropy in the Onset of the Luminosity Bump," the research was conducted by Saskia Hekker, a professor of theoretical astrophysics and group leader at the Heidelberg Institute for Theoretical Studies. Stars that have exhausted their hydrogen fuel follow a predictable path in luminosity-temperature space. Low-mass stars, specifically those on the red-giant branch (RGB), exhibit an increase in luminosity and decrease in surface temperature as they evolve. However, this trend is disrupted by a temporary decrease in luminosity known as the luminosity bump. While theoretical models and observations confirm the existence of the luminosity bump, there's a discrepancy between the two. In simulations, the bump appears at higher luminosities than observed, indicating that it occurs later than expected. This inconsistency suggests that the underlying physics driving the bump needs to be re-examined. Stars like our sun have distinct layers, but those on the RGB stage are characterized by a different energy production process. Unlike their main-sequence counterparts, RGB stars rely on fusion in a thin shell surrounding an inert helium core. Energy transport within these regions occurs primarily through radiation. The layered structure of RGB stars is crucial to understanding the onset of the luminosity bump. As hydrogen fuel is depleted from the core, most of the remaining energy is stored in the star's envelope. This unique configuration sets the stage for the temporary decrease in luminosity that marks the start of the bump. As an RGB star undergoes significant changes during its ascent of the branch, its core contracts while the surface expands outward. The inert helium core exerts inward pressure due to its lack of outward force, prompting a response in the convective outer envelope. The deepest layers of this envelope are forced inward, reaching regions that have undergone chemical alteration through earlier burning processes within the star's evolution. This movement triggers dredge-up, as deeper layers are propelled into the convective zone, where they mix with material from the radiative zone and alter its composition accordingly. The boundary between the convective and radiative zones deep within the star is a critical area of study. Known as the base of the convective zone (BCZ), it's governed by the thermodynamic property of specific entropy, which measures the disorder of gas at this juncture. As the BCZ shifts deeper into the star, the difference in entropy across its boundary gradually decreases until it drops below a critical value. As researchers delve into the mystery of aging stars' sudden luminosity dips, they've been re-examining previous theories that attributed these events to mechanical interactions within the star. Theories based on mechanics suggested that when a thin hydrogen-burning shell reached the boundary with another layer inside the star, something changed, triggering the dip. However, this explanation has been found lacking as it failed to account for the underlying thermodynamics of the star's internal workings. Astrophysicists face significant challenges in studying stars due to their opaque nature; they can't directly observe what's happening within them. To overcome this limitation, researchers rely on theoretical physics and test these models against observable data from the star's outer layers. The new explanation for the luminosity dip is a crucial development in astrophysical theory, as it provides a quantitative description of how the bump occurs when an entropy threshold is crossed inside the star. This breakthrough will contribute to the refinement of stellar evolution models by providing a more accurate understanding of the mechanisms driving these dips in luminosity. A sudden drop in luminosity is a common phenomenon observed in aging stars, and researchers have now identified specific entropy as a key factor contributing to this occurrence. This breakthrough will refine stellar evolution models by providing a more accurate understanding of the mechanisms driving these dips in luminosity. The findings suggest that changes in specific entropy play a crucial role in triggering these events. Specific entropy refers to the amount of thermal energy contained within a star's core, and its fluctuations can significantly impact the star's overall brightness. articles.title: Mac Application Caches Can Take Up Valuable Storage Space
articles.summary: Temporary files stored in app caches can take up valuable storage space on a Mac, and clearing them can help reclaim storage space and resolve app glitches.
articles.content: Clearing application caches on a Mac has become a necessary task for many users. Temporary files stored in app caches can take up valuable storage space, even when an application no longer needs them. These caches include image previews, downloaded content, and other data that help apps launch quickly and serve content without additional processing. Developers recommend this practice to prevent apps from creating or redownloading the same files each time they are used. Google Chrome is a notable example of an app that builds its cache as users visit different websites. When you visit a website, parts of the webpage, like images, are cached by Google Chrome. This helps speed up load times when visiting the same website again in the future. However, leaving these caches unchecked can lead to problems. Problems with app caches can cause glitches such as displaying outdated or inaccurate content. Additionally, there's no guarantee that a Mac will automatically manage temporary files stored in app caches. This is why knowing how to clear app caches on your Mac is essential for resolving issues arising from an outdated cache and reclaiming storage space wasted on bloating caches. When clearing the application cache on a Mac, some apps offer an easy solution within their settings menu. For instance, Safari and Apple Music allow users to clear app caches from within the app itself. However, not all Mac applications provide this convenience. To access the hidden library folder where app caches are typically stored, navigate to Finder and press command + shift + H. Next, click on View > Show Library Folder in the menu bar. This will reveal the library folder, which can be found at ~/library/caches. Once inside the library folder, use the shortcut command + J to display a checkbox labeled "Calculate all sizes." Checking this box will show folder sizes alongside their names, making it easier to identify large folders and locate the app cache you want to clear. Clearing app caches on a Mac can help reclaim storage space and resolve app glitches, but it may also temporarily slow down application performance as the cache is rebuilt. Deleting app caches indiscriminately or making it a regular maintenance routine is not recommended, as this can disrupt the smooth user experience that apps rely on these temporary files to provide. However, if an app is malfunctioning or consuming excessive storage space, clearing its cache may be necessary to restore functionality and free up disk space. Once you've cleared an app's cache and it has rebuilt itself, your application should return to normal operation, with no noticeable lag or sluggishness in performance. articles.title: Kirk Cousins leads Minnesota Vikings to victory over Washington Commanders
articles.summary: The Minnesota Vikings have won their latest game with quarterback Kirk Cousins leading them to a victory over the Washington Commanders.
articles.content: The trade deadline has come and gone in the NFL, leaving behind its early aftermath in Week 10. While some teams are still waiting for their new players to make an impact, others have already seen significant changes on the field. Among those who made a splash is Kirk Cousins, who led his new team, the Minnesota Vikings, to victory over the Washington Commanders. This marks just one of several trades that have shaken up the league since the deadline passed. Not all transactions have been as successful, however. Marvin Harrison Jr., acquired by the Houston Texans in a recent deal, struggled in his first few games with the team and was inactive on Sunday. Despite these setbacks, the Texans were initially in a strong position to turn their season around after an underwhelming start. With C.J. Stroud playing some of the best football of his career, they held a 17-point lead over the Cleveland Browns at halftime. The Texans' defense has been a major disappointment this year, but many expected it to step up against the Browns. Unfortunately for Houston fans, their team's defense failed to deliver in the second and third quarters, allowing Cleveland to score 20 unanswered points. Cleveland quarterback Deshaun Watson played a key role in his team's comeback victory, throwing for 312 yards and a touchdown while also rushing for 49 yards and another score. The Browns' win over the Texans is their fourth at home this season, matching a milestone that was last achieved in 1963. Houston's inability to stop opponents from scoring has been a recurring issue throughout their season. Despite making changes to their coaching staff, including switching play-callers, they have yet to find success on defense. Each of their last four opponents has managed at least 21 points against them. The Texans' woes on defense are now compounded by the failure of one of their recent trades, with Marvin Harrison Jr.'s inactivity and lack of production adding to their problems. The Texans' season is rapidly spiraling out of control as they find themselves three games behind .500 at 3-6. With their postseason hopes dwindling by the day, Houston's margin for error has all but vanished. A team in NFL history has managed to start a year with an abysmal 0-4 record and still make the playoffs, but that feat is far from guaranteed. The reasons behind a poor start are often season-defining, and it appears that the Texans' woes may be more than just a minor blip on their radar. The Vikings, meanwhile, have breathed new life into their offense with quarterback Kirk Cousins at the helm. One game into his reunion with the franchise, he's already delivered what was envisioned: improvement to an underwhelming attack. Minnesota's top-ranked defense did its part in shutting down the Green Bay Packers, and instead of relying solely on their stellar defensive play, the Vikings were able to pull away from their opponents. Cousins' statistics read 21-for-31 for 207 yards, two touchdowns, and an interception. He also managed to free Justin Jefferson from his season-long frustration by targeting him nine times for a total of 74 yards. As a result, the Vikings secured their second 30-point outing of the campaign. The Cousins trade has already proved to be a masterstroke for Minnesota's front office, snapping a two-game losing skid and solidifying a head-to-head tiebreaker over the Packers in the division. Other teams that made notable moves at the trade deadline also reaped rewards this week. Kansas City Chiefs wide receiver Josh Downs and Buffalo Bills safety Amani Hooker both had standout performances in blowout wins for their respective teams. The 35 points scored by the Chiefs, which included Downs' longest touchdown since 2024, marked the second consecutive week they've reached that milestone. Meanwhile, Hooker's seven tackles ranked third on the Bills defense, a testament to his impact in his new role. The San Francisco 49ers' offense was firing on all cylinders against the Dallas Cowboys, with explosive plays coming at a rapid pace. Christian McCaffrey made his presence felt early with a 74-yard receiving touchdown, showcasing his skills as a versatile playmaker. The score marked a career high for McCaffrey in terms of yardage. McCaffrey's impressive performance was only matched by his ability to make big plays after the catch. Later in the game, he broke free for a 66-yard gain on a catch-and-run that left defenders grasping at air. This display of speed and agility underlined McCaffrey's value as a dynamic threat. Meanwhile, Deebo Samuel made his presence felt with an electrifying 70-yard run on a reverse play. The Dallas defense was caught completely off guard by the unexpected burst of speed from Samuel, who had been quiet for much of the game up until that point. His ability to make big plays in space is a key component of the 49ers' high-powered offense. The Cowboys, meanwhile, were left to ponder what could have been after their defense blew a crucial opportunity to capitalize on the New York Giants' loss and move closer to the NFC East lead. Their failure to contain McCaffrey and Samuel was a major factor in their inability to secure victory. In other news, several high-profile players made their debuts with new teams following the NFL's trade deadline. Jordan Davis and Jessie Bates III were among those watching from the sidelines as their new team, the Jacksonville Jaguars, rolled over the Tennessee Titans. The duo had not yet hit their bye weeks when they were traded to Jacksonville. Despite being absent from the lineup, the Jaguars still managed to put on an impressive display against a struggling opponent. Their 40-23 victory marked a convincing statement of intent for a team that is starting to come into its own as a legitimate Super Bowl contender. The fact that they can win big games without their new stars is a promising sign. The absence of Davis and Bates was particularly notable given the thinness at certain positions on the Jaguars' defense in recent weeks. Their contributions would likely have made a significant difference in the outcome, but it's clear that the team has depth and talent to spare. The real test will come when they face off against Tennessee again at home in two weeks. In a separate incident, Detroit Lions star edge rusher Aidan Hutchinson suffered a non-contact knee injury while celebrating a sack on New England Patriots quarterback Drake Maye in Munich. The unfortunate nature of the injury, which occurred while Hutchinson was landing awkwardly after his celebration, has left him sidelined for an uncertain period. The news from Detroit is not good for Lions fans, as Aidan Hutchinson's injury has left his future uncertain. Initial tests suggest that he may have sustained a significant injury, forcing him and the team to seek second opinions. This could be a devastating blow to a defense that has been gaining momentum. Hutchinson's injury occurred in an unusual manner - while celebrating a sack. The unfortunate nature of this incident has left many wondering what might have been avoided. As it stands now, Hutchinson's season may be over before he even had the chance to make significant contributions. The Lions' defense has been one of the most improved units in the league this season. They've managed to limit opposing teams' yardage and haven't allowed more than two touchdowns in a game since October 11. With Hutchinson sidelined, it will be tough for them to maintain this streak. Patrick Mahomes is making a strong case for Comeback Player of the Year with his incredible performances on the field. His latest outing against the Atlanta Falcons was one for the books - he passed for 348 yards and five touchdowns. This has also given him a new record in the NFL, surpassing Peyton Manning's mark. Mahomes' success wasn't just about his passing skills; he had help from rookie Emmett Johnson on the ground. The young running back picked up where star player Kenneth Walker III left off, linking up with Mahomes six times for 70 yards and two touchdowns through the air. Despite an impressive display by Mahomes, it's worth noting that the Kansas City Chiefs were able to get past Atlanta's defense even without a key contributor on the ground. This speaks volumes about the team's depth and ability to adapt. Fernando Mendoza had his first start in what could be a promising career. While he managed to score a touchdown and hold his own against a tough Seattle Seahawks defense, it wasn't enough to secure a win for the Las Vegas Raiders. The rest of his supporting cast and the team's defense let them down in a 21-13 loss. The defeat for the Raiders was disappointing, especially considering Mendoza's individual performance. However, this is just one game, and there will be plenty more opportunities for him to make an impact. The struggles of Fernando Mendoza, the young quarterback for the Raiders, were evident on Sunday as he was left without adequate protection from his offensive line. This lack of support allowed six sacks to be recorded against him, making it a tough day at the office. The running game also failed to impress, with Ashton Jeanty and Mike Washington Jr. averaging just 2.4 yards per carry between them. The absence of Brock Bowers due to an ankle injury further exacerbated the situation, as the wide receivers were unable to make an impact in his place. This was particularly noticeable when it came to making plays downfield, where they failed to register any significant gains. The defense, on the other hand, did manage to put pressure on Mendoza in the second half. In a game that saw the Raiders' young quarterback facing a tough challenge, he was ultimately unable to overcome the obstacles in his path. Despite some promising moments, Mendoza's performance was hindered by the lack of support from those around him. As the team continues to rebuild, it is clear that they still have a long way to go before becoming a cohesive unit. The Los Angeles Rams, meanwhile, had their own set of challenges to overcome in their game against the Arizona Cardinals. Despite being without key players such as Puka Nacua and Davante Adams due to injury, they were able to roll to a convincing 34-6 victory on the road. This outcome was all the more impressive given the circumstances. The Rams' depth proved to be a major factor in their success, with multiple playmakers making significant contributions throughout the game. On defense, Byron Young, Braden Fiske, Tyler Davis, and Shaun Dolac each recorded a sack against rookie quarterback Carson Beck. Aaron Donald also had an impact, recording 1.5 sacks and bringing down the quarterback for the first time since his return to the team. In addition to their strong defensive performance, the Rams' offense was also able to make some big plays. Matthew Stafford threw three touchdowns, while Blake Corum racked up over 100 yards on the ground. This marked the second such game of his young career as a leader in the rushing attack. The Cardinals, meanwhile, were dealing with their own set of issues behind center. With their starting quarterback out injured and their wide receiver group struggling to find its footing, they found themselves at a significant disadvantage against the Rams. Despite this, they were able to hold their own for much of the game before ultimately falling short. In the end, it was another impressive win for the Los Angeles Rams, who continue to demonstrate their depth and versatility as a team. With multiple playmakers making significant contributions, they are proving themselves to be a force to be reckoned with in the league. The Patriots' injury woes continue to plague them as they struggle to stay healthy throughout the season. A staggering 42 players have taken to the field for New England this year, averaging nearly two starters per position. The number is likely to swell next week if Drake Maye's ankle injury forces him to sit out. The third-year quarterback left the game after just one drive following a play that also saw Hutchinson suffer a knee issue. The absence of key players has significantly impacted the team's performance on the field, making an already concerning situation even more dire for the Patriots. Tommy DeVito entered the game in relief of Maye but failed to make a significant impact, completing only 12 passes out of 24 attempts for 81 yards and a touchdown, while also throwing an interception. The offense struggled to find its rhythm without Maye on the field. The Panthers have emerged as a surprise contender in the NFC South, despite their mediocre record. They are poised to become the first team in the division to claim four consecutive winning seasons. articles.title: Netgear recommends upgrading hardware every four or five years to avoid connectivity issues and security risks
articles.summary: Your home network is vulnerable to security breaches due to outdated devices connected to it.
articles.content: Your home network is vulnerable to security breaches due to outdated devices connected to it. A 10-year-old camera may seem perfectly functional, but its age can make it a weak link in your network's security. Manufacturers typically stop providing updates for such old devices, leaving them exposed to potential threats. This lack of support can have serious consequences if not addressed promptly. Replacing security cameras every five to seven years is essential to maintaining the integrity of your home network. Router manufacturer Netgear recommends upgrading hardware every four or five years to avoid connectivity issues and security risks. Slower connections are often a clear indication that it's time for a change. The FBI issued a warning in 2025 about end-of-life routers being compromised by cybercriminals. These devices, no longer receiving software updates or security patches, can be used to send sensitive data to malicious actors or even become part of a botnet. It is crucial for consumers to regularly audit their devices and determine if they pose a security risk. The vulnerability of smart devices in homes is a growing concern, particularly those that no longer receive software updates or security patches. According to a 2024 study by Consumer Reports, many appliance manufacturers do not clearly communicate how long they will provide support for their products. This lack of transparency can leave consumers unaware of the potential risks associated with older devices. In fact, out of 19 major brands examined in the study, only three provided customers with information on how long they would maintain software updates. Even among these three, the longest promised period was a mere five years, falling short of consumer expectations for at least ten years of support. Routers are another common household device that can pose significant security risks if not regularly updated. A 2025 warning from the FBI advised replacing routers dated 2010 or earlier due to their likelihood of no longer receiving updates. Malware like TheMoon, which targets routers and installs proxies for anonymous criminal activity, is a prime example of the dangers posed by outdated routers. TheMoon hack exploits open ports and vulnerable scripts, rendering even strong passwords ineffective in protecting against it. This highlights the importance of keeping all connected devices up to date, not just those with easily accessible ports or interfaces. Older devices can also be recruited into botnets, networks of compromised devices used to overwhelm websites with traffic and take them offline. A recent report from Cisco found that nearly 40 percent of targeted vulnerabilities affected end-of-life devices, while about a third of exploited vulnerabilities were at least ten years old. This trend suggests that attackers continue to target older hardware because it rarely gets fixed or updated. Even if most home smart devices are current, the presence of just one outdated device can create an entry point for malicious actors and compromise other connected devices in the network. A thorough inventory of connected devices in a home network can reveal forgotten items like an old camera or smart plug that may be out of date and susceptible to hacking. These devices often go unnoticed until they become a vulnerability in the system. Manufacturers typically stop issuing updates for older gadgets, leaving them exposed to security threats. Checking online for update availability is a simple step towards securing the network. If a device no longer receives firmware updates or is an end-of-life product, it's likely time to remove it from the network. Upgrading the router to the latest standard, WPA3, can significantly boost security. The process involves accessing the router's admin page and selecting the wireless security setting. However, some older gadgets may struggle to connect after the switch, so choosing the WPA2/WPA3 option might be necessary in such cases. In addition to updating the router, turning off remote management and using a strong password can add an extra layer of protection. The default password provided by manufacturers should never be used, as it's easily guessable. Automatic updates for firmware ensure that vulnerabilities are addressed promptly. Older gadgets and smart appliances can be isolated on a separate network to prevent them from compromising more critical devices like laptops or phones. This setup creates a barrier between the vulnerable devices and the rest of the network. By taking these steps, homeowners can significantly reduce the risk of their home network being compromised by outdated devices. articles.title: Mobile Hotspots Can Be Convenient but Come with Trade-Offs
articles.summary: Using a phone as a mobile hotspot can be a convenient option when traditional internet options are not available, but it also comes with trade-offs such as impacting data plans and battery life.
articles.content: When traveling or working remotely, a mobile hotspot can be a lifesaver when there's no Wi-Fi network available to connect to. Fortunately, most phones are equipped with the ability to share their cellular data connection with other devices. This feature is often found under "Hotspot & Tethering on Android devices and as Personal Hotspot" on iPhones. Using your phone as a mobile hotspot is particularly useful in situations where traditional internet options are not readily available, such as when working or traveling from place to place. While portable hotspot devices can be purchased, the convenience of simply flipping a switch on your phone's settings often makes more sense. However, this option does come with its own set of trade-offs that need to be carefully considered. Remote work and travel have become increasingly common in recent times, leading to an increased demand for portable internet solutions. As people venture further away from traditional office spaces and home desks, the need to stay connected on the go has never been greater. With more options available than ever before, it's essential to weigh up the pros and cons of using your phone as a mobile hotspot. When deciding whether or not to use your phone as a mobile hotspot, one of the key considerations is the impact on your data plan and battery life. As appealing as this option may be, there are potential drawbacks that need to be taken into account before making a decision. Setting up your laptop to access the internet at a coffee shop or other public location can be a straightforward process when using your phone as a mobile hotspot. Grab your phone, turn on the hotspot feature, and connect your laptop - it's a simple task that doesn't require any additional equipment. The convenience of this setup is one of its main advantages. You don't have to worry about carrying around an extra device to charge or update, which can be a hassle when traveling. This also means you can use your phone for all the usual activities like making calls and sending texts without having to manage another gadget. Using your phone as a mobile hotspot is particularly useful in situations where you need internet access on the go. Whether you're connecting your own laptop or setting up an internet connection for family members, this option provides flexibility and convenience. It's also cost-effective since you don't have to purchase a dedicated hotspot device with its associated data plan. The safety aspect of using a mobile hotspot is another important consideration. When accessing public Wi-Fi networks, there's always the risk of encountering malicious activity or unsecured connections. Using your phone as a hotspot allows you to control who connects to it, which reduces this risk compared to joining open Wi-Fi networks. To ensure security when using your phone as a mobile hotspot, it's essential to set up strong passwords and use encryption. This will prevent unauthorized access to your network. For individuals who only need occasional backup internet connections, the benefits of using their phone in this way often outweigh any potential drawbacks. The decision to use your phone as a mobile hotspot should be based on your specific needs and circumstances. While it offers several advantages over dedicated devices, there are also some potential downsides that you'll want to consider before making a choice. Using your phone as a mobile hotspot can be convenient, but it also has its drawbacks. One significant concern is the impact on battery life - running a hotspot consumes power quickly, causing your battery to drain faster than usual. This issue can be mitigated by using a power bank or an external charger to top up your device's battery. However, this might not always be practical, especially if you're in a situation where access to a charger is limited. A data plan's hotspot limitations are another consideration. If your plan has a cap on the amount of data that can be used for tethering, exceeding it may result in slower internet speeds or higher costs at the end of the month. The number of devices connected to your mobile hotspot also affects performance - as more devices join, speeds tend to slow down due to shared bandwidth. To activate mobile hotspot on an Android device, navigate to the quick settings panel by pulling it down from the top of the screen, then tap on the Mobile Hotspot icon. This action typically leads directly to a configuration menu where you can set up a network name and password, as well as choose between different frequency bands such as 2.4GHz or 5GHz. The configuration process for iPhones is similar, with users opening the Settings app, then selecting Personal Hotspot (or Cellular, then Personal Hotspot) from within it. Here, they must toggle on Allow Others to Join and set a secure Wi-Fi password to prevent unauthorized access to their network. For occasional use, leveraging your phone as a hotspot can be a convenient option that often incurs no additional costs, provided your data plan includes hotspot data. This approach saves you money by eliminating the need for extra purchases or devices, while still allowing you to stay connected when needed. However, if you frequently tether multiple devices or engage in resource-intensive activities such as streaming video, the limitations of using your phone as a hotspot become apparent. In such cases, investing in a dedicated mobile hotspot device may be the more practical solution, despite its higher upfront cost. Ultimately, the best approach depends on your specific needs and data usage patterns, which should be carefully reviewed before making a decision to ensure you're choosing the most suitable option for your circumstances. articles.title: Cloud Storage vs Local Storage: Weighing the Pros and Cons
articles.summary: Cloud storage offers numerous benefits, including automatic file syncing, reduced risk of lost files, and increased accessibility from multiple devices.
articles.content: Newscentral.site has analyzed the pros and cons of using cloud storage over local storage for backing up files. Using external hard drives or USB flash drives is often a straightforward way to back up important data without relying on an internet connection. The process typically involves simply plugging in the device, copying files from your computer, and then disconnecting it. This method is particularly useful when you need immediate access to your backed-up files. In contrast, cloud storage services like iCloud and Google Drive require a stable internet connection to upload and sync data. Cloud-based solutions offer numerous benefits, including automatic syncing of files such as photos, videos, contacts, and more. The absence of manual file copying saves time, while the risk of losing files due to misplaced or damaged external drives is significantly reduced. However, it's essential to note that cloud storage has its drawbacks, making local storage a viable alternative in certain situations. When deciding between cloud storage and local storage, several factors come into play. Access to your backed-up data is a significant consideration, with local storage, you can access files instantly without relying on an internet connection. Cost is another factor, as some cloud services may charge subscription fees or impose storage limits. Reliability is also crucial, with both options having their own set of potential issues and risks. The debate over the merits of cloud storage versus local storage continues to be a contentious issue among tech enthusiasts and everyday users alike. The convenience of cloud storage lies in its ability to liberate users from the burden of managing their files on a single device. With cloud storage, files are accessible from anywhere, at any time, provided there is an internet connection. This freedom to access files across multiple devices has become increasingly appealing to individuals who frequently switch between laptops and smartphones. The seamless transfer of data between devices is made possible by automatic syncing features offered by most cloud services. For instance, users can enable iCloud's backup feature on their device to ensure that all files are securely stored in the cloud every day. This synchronization process allows users to pick up where they left off on any device, without having to manually transfer files. Cloud storage platforms have also made it easier for users to share files with others. Once a file is uploaded to the cloud, sharing becomes a simple matter of clicking a button. The cloud platform generates a link that can be shared with anyone, allowing them to view or download the file as needed. Collaboration on documents and spreadsheets has become more streamlined through cloud-based platforms like Google Docs. Multiple users can work on the same project simultaneously, with features like real-time commenting available to facilitate communication among team members. Cloud storage offers a significant advantage in terms of safety, as major providers keep multiple copies of user data across various servers and data centers. This redundancy ensures that even if one server experiences issues, others can still access the data. Furthermore, cloud accounts can be secured with robust password protection and two-factor authentication, preventing unauthorized access to sensitive files. However, relying on a stable internet connection is essential for cloud storage, as outages or slow connections can hinder access to crucial files. Users may experience frustration when attempting to download large files over a slow connection, which can take an inordinate amount of time. In contrast, external solid-state drives (SSDs) enable rapid file transfers, making them a more convenient option. For individuals who frequently travel and rely on mobile data, cloud storage's dependence on internet connectivity becomes a significant concern. Local storage solutions like external SSDs are not affected by internet outages or slow connections, providing greater flexibility in remote areas. This is particularly important for those working with large files or requiring constant access to their digital assets. The cost factor is another consideration that may deter people from using cloud services. While initial purchases of external hard drives require a one-time payment, cloud providers typically charge recurring subscription fees on a monthly or annual basis. Apple's iCloud+ service, for example, charges $9.99 per month in the US for 2TB of storage. This translates to nearly $240 over two years, with the added risk that files may be deleted if payments are not made. Moreover, users should be aware of possible price increases down the road. By comparison, a 2TB SSD can be purchased for around $290, providing permanent ownership without additional fees. While cloud storage offers many benefits, its limitations and drawbacks must be carefully weighed against those of local storage solutions. Users need to consider their specific needs and circumstances before deciding which option best suits them. When deciding between cloud storage and local storage, it's essential to weigh both options carefully. Cloud services offer the convenience of accessing files from anywhere, but they also raise concerns about data security and reliability. Users can benefit from a hybrid approach by storing frequently used files locally while offloading larger or less important ones to the cloud. This way, they can enjoy the benefits of both worlds without committing entirely to one method. Engadget : https://www.engadget.com/2313943/pros-cons-using-cloud-storage-over-local/

articles.title: Mediterranean Islands' Funeral Traditions Revealed through Ceramic Analysis
articles.summary: A recent study conducted by researchers from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona and other institutions has shed new light on the contents of characteristic island containers used in funeral rituals.
articles.content: The Mediterranean islands of Menorca and the Balearics have been found to have maintained unique funeral traditions for over 2,000 years, despite increasing connections with the wider region. One such tradition involved burying loved ones in rock-cut tombs, or artificial caves, often accompanied by animal offerings made in external courtyards. Archaeologists suspect that perishable foods and liquids were also offered in characteristic island containers, but until now, the contents of these ceramic vessels had remained a mystery. A recent study conducted by researchers from the Universitat Autònoma de Barcelona (UAB) and other institutions has shed new light on this practice. The analysis of 34 ceramic vessels recovered from Cave 45 of the sepulchral complex of Calescoves revealed that most were used to store dairy products, with smaller amounts containing wine. The presence of wine is particularly notable, as it was a product of foreign origin, likely introduced by Mediterranean cultures such as the Punic world. The study's findings provide evidence that wine was incorporated into Menorcan funeral rituals during this period, highlighting the island's cultural exchange with other regions. This discovery adds to our understanding of the unique traditions and practices of the Balearic Islands. Researchers analyzed organic residues from the ceramic vessels using advanced techniques, allowing them to identify the substances stored within. The results show that dairy products were the primary contents of these containers, while wine was a secondary offering in some cases. The presence of foreign-inspired ceramics on the island suggests that cultural exchange and trade played an important role in shaping Menorcan funerary traditions during this period. Further research is needed to fully understand the significance of these findings and their implications for our understanding of Mediterranean cultures. The analysis of ceramics from Menorca's post-Talayotic period has uncovered new information about the island's inhabitants' relationships with other regions. Local communities adopted foreign ceramic forms but continued to use them for their original purpose: storing wine. According to researcher Sònia Carbonell, this indicates that trade networks played a significant role in introducing wine to the island. The demand for wine was likely driven by specific individuals or prominent groups within post-Talayotic communities, rather than a widespread trend. This suggests that the introduction of wine was not a replacement of local traditions but an adaptation of those elements to fit their own cultural codes. Carbonell emphasizes that this highlights the persistence and reaffirmation of Menorca's distinct cultural identity in a context of exchanges. The study sheds light on the purpose and use of high-bottomed vessels characteristic of Menorcan funerary practices. By examining the contents and function of these vessels, researchers can resolve questions about ceramic typology. The findings also demonstrate how the study of everyday objects can reveal complex social dynamics and cultural practices. Researchers have long debated the purpose of a small, globular-bodied vessel with a pouring spout found in Menorcan infant burials. The study validates the hypothesis that this vessel was used as a baby bottle. This discovery speaks to child-rearing practices and how they were incorporated into funerary rituals. The findings suggest that the practice of using vessels as baby bottles may have been more widespread than previously thought. Margalida Coll notes that these vessels reveal information about people feeding infants and the care they received, which is an important aspect of human culture. The discovery of high-bottomed vessels in Menorcan funerary rituals has shed light on the symbolic consumption of milk and wine over 2,000 years ago. These small vessels suggest that offerings or symbolic consumption of limited quantities were a significant aspect of these ancient rituals. The study's findings also indicate that different areas within the cave complex served distinct purposes. For instance, items like infant feeding bottles accompanied the deceased inside the burial chamber, while other vessels in the courtyard likely represented the actions of the living at the tomb's entrance. A substantial portion of the "ritual ware recovered from the site in 2023 and 2024 were remarkably well-preserved, with many pieces still intact. The collection includes a range of vessel types, such as juglets with side handles, jugs, bowls, conical vessels typical to the Balearic Islands, and incense-burner-type vessels. In addition to dairy products and wine, analysis revealed the presence of animal fats and various vegetable oils among the offerings. This diversity of substances underscores the complexity of these ancient rituals and the significance attributed to specific items. The researchers employed an innovative approach by combining scanning with micro-excavation and chemical analysis to analyze organic residues on the artifacts. This methodology allowed for a more efficient examination of the small high-bottomed vessels, which would have been challenging using traditional methods due to their limited capacity and size. They were discovered in various settings, including ritual sanctuaries and domestic homes known as circles. Their presence is most common in funerary contexts, where they often appear in large numbers. The analysis has also documented the use of dairy residues in most of these vessels. Animal fats were identified in a smaller minority of the high-bottomed vessels, alongside the more commonly found dairy residues. The recent discovery of residues on Menorcan funerary vessels has shed new light on the possible functionality of these objects. Researchers suggest that the presence of dairy products in most of these vessels could be a local adaptation of incense burners found in other ancient cultures. Alternatively, the vessels may have been crafted by specific individuals, and their deposition in funerary contexts may reflect a unique expression of individuality. The discovery of dairy residues has significant implications for understanding the role of milk and its derivatives in the diet of post-Talayotic communities. This finding takes on added importance when considering the importance of milk products in the daily lives of these ancient people. The study's methodology provides a valuable framework for future research into funerary spaces and objects in archaeological contexts, offering new perspectives on their role within ritual and funerary practices. The researchers emphasize that the identification of dairy residues is particularly significant, given the crucial role of milk products in the diet of post-Talayotic communities. The study revealed that dairy residues were found at several archaeological sites on the island of Menorca, a region known for its rich cultural heritage. These residues were detected in ceramic vessels and stone mortars, suggesting that milk was consumed during funerary rituals over 2,000 years ago, likely mixed with wine. We have identified residues of dairy products in ancient ceramics," one researcher noted. The presence of these substances reinforces the idea that milk played a vital role in the diet of post-Talayotic communities. articles.title: Kunal Bahl's Journey as an Entrepreneur Begins Amid Visa Challenges
articles.summary: Kunal Bahl's entrepreneurial ambitions were initially hindered by his visa status, but he eventually found a way forward after the rejection of his H-1B petition.
articles.content: Kunal Bahl's journey as an entrepreneur began in his formative years, with a clear inclination towards starting his own business ventures. Growing up in New Delhi had a significant impact on his entrepreneurial spirit, which was further fueled by his educational background at the University of Pennsylvania, where he pursued a unique program that combined engineering and business studies. The tech industry's rapid growth during his college days, marked by notable events like Google's public offering and Facebook's viral popularity, created an environment conducive to entrepreneurship. By 2006, when Bahl graduated, the internet economy was booming. However, his visa status presented a significant hurdle in pursuing his entrepreneurial ambitions, as he was required to find an employer willing to sponsor his H-1B visa before laying out a pathway into Silicon Valley and attempting to start his own company. The rejection of his H-1B visa petition was a turning point in his career, setting him on a path he wouldn't have chosen otherwise. He had been working at Microsoft since graduating and was waiting for his Optional Practical Training to expire when the news arrived. In June or July 2007, an email informed him that his H-1B petition had been rejected. The initial shock gave way to confusion as he struggled to understand why this had happened. Given his employer and the role he held, it seemed unfathomable that his visa wouldn't be approved. He sought clarity from his colleagues at Microsoft, only to find that there was a sense of finality in their responses. Their suggestion to work in the India office and reapply for the H-1B after a year offered little comfort. At this point, he had never considered leaving the US, but the rejection forced him to reassess his priorities. He began to see the possibility of working for himself as an attractive alternative to navigating the complexities of the visa process. With the burden of dealing with the H-1B situation lifted, he started to think about building a business in India. This marked a significant shift from his earlier plans and set him on a new trajectory that would ultimately lead to success. The freedom from visa and green card worries allowed me to focus on my entrepreneurial ambitions without distraction. I reached out to Rohit Bansal, a high school friend now working in finance, to explore potential business opportunities together. Our conversations about starting a company dated back to our days sitting next to each other in class. He was receptive to the idea of collaborating and I asked if he wanted to make it happen. " Our company was formally established on September 12, 2007, just before my return to India. The Indian startup scene has undergone significant transformation since then. In 2007, however, the country's digital landscape was underdeveloped with limited internet users, smartphones, and digital payment options. This created a somewhat stagnant environment for innovation. Despite being back in his home country, I wasn't returning to a thriving hub of entrepreneurial activity. The prevailing attitude towards starting one's own business was skeptical, with people questioning why someone with a good education wouldn't pursue employment instead. When Rohit and I were starting out, angel investors weren't a common phenomenon, making it difficult for us to find funding for our venture. We had managed to save about $60,000 in total from our corporate jobs, which we pooled together as seed capital for our business. That amount was crucial in helping us get started, and we made the most of it by staying with our families for food and accommodation while working out of a small office in Delhi's furniture market. The office was located in the basement of a residential building, but that didn't deter us from putting in long hours, 20 hours a day, to be exact, to get our business off the ground. The rejection of my H-1B visa proved to be a turning point in my career, leading me down an unexpected path that ultimately benefited my entrepreneurial endeavors. In retrospect, not obtaining the visa allowed me to fulfill a long-held ambition: helping the next generation of founders in India succeed. This goal became achievable only by returning to my home country and immersing myself in its rapidly evolving startup ecosystem. The current landscape in India is vastly different from what it was when I first started out. The country now boasts an impressive one billion internet users, widespread smartphone penetration, and a plethora of coworking spaces catering to startup founders. This environment has created a fertile ground for innovation and growth. Given these favorable conditions, there's no better time than the present for individuals like me who wish to contribute to India's burgeoning tech scene and help drive its continued progress as a global leader in innovation. articles.title: Pentagon Launches FORTRESS Initiative to Ensure Military Base Self-Sufficiency
articles.summary: The US military is preparing for potential disruptions by launching a plan to ensure the self-sufficiency of major bases in the event of war.
articles.content: Americans are feeling overwhelmed by a series of crises that seem to be unfolding simultaneously. The past month has been particularly grueling, with multiple challenges testing their resilience. The Pentagon's FORTRESS initiative, launched on September 30th, is one such concern. This plan aims to ensure the self-sufficiency of major US military bases in the event of a war disrupting power and supply chains. Portable nuclear reactors, large-scale battery storage, and microgrids are part of this strategy. The FORTRESS plan also involves stockpiling vital resources like munitions, fuel, critical minerals, electronics, spare parts, and medical supplies. These strategic reserves would enable bases to operate independently for up to 90 days without external assistance. As if these developments weren't alarming enough, a series of cyberattacks has swept the globe, affecting hundreds of companies and institutions. This hacking spree has been dubbed "Black October, with targets including the Federal Election Commission, Sony, John Deere, Oracle Health, Burger King Japan, and the State Bank of India. The UK government has been advising citizens to stockpile essential supplies in preparation for potential disruptions, recommending that people keep canned food, bottled water, and cash on hand to last at least three days. Cybersecurity experts were working overtime to address a critical vulnerability in the PHP programming language, which is used by nearly 70% of all websites. The National Security Agency issued a warning that if left unpatched, this weakness could allow attackers to take control of affected web servers. The hacking spree known as Black October reached new heights with a massive cryptocurrency heist, with North Korean hackers making off with a staggering $6.3 billion from the exchange Binance. In related news, the US midterm elections saw a significant shift in power, with Democrats sweeping races across traditionally Republican strongholds and several candidates who campaigned on restricting data centers winning their seats. The stock market's brief respite from turmoil was short-lived as another bombshell rocked investors last weekend. Jensen Huang, co-founder and CEO of Nvidia, admitted to having an affair with a woman suspected of being a Chinese spy. The revelation sparked a chain reaction: Nvidia's stock plummeted as markets anticipated tighter restrictions on chip exports, while the sudden departure of Huang, who had not designated a successor, put at risk the circular" financing deals he had made with companies throughout the AI ecosystem. The consequences were far-reaching, threatening to upend the delicate balance of power in the global tech industry. The Nvidia affair also shed light on China's extensive industrial espionage efforts, which could potentially tip the scales in the high-stakes AI race that may determine economic and military supremacy. This development has significant implications for companies and governments alike, as they navigate the complex web of alliances and rivalries in the tech world. In a separate but related incident, Microsoft's suite of software tools went offline on Thursday, crippling email, calendars, and collaboration functions, among others. According to the company, the outage was caused by a technical issue resulting from an earlier network capacity upgrade that had been triggered by a recent network change. The FAA's decision to ground all air traffic in the US was a drastic measure that sent shockwaves through the aviation industry. A communications node in Arkansas had recently undergone an upgrade from copper wire to fiber-optic cables, which caused routers across the air traffic control system to become overwhelmed with connection attempts. The node is a critical part of the air traffic control network and its failure led to some radar feeds being disrupted. The disruption was so severe that the FAA ordered the ground stop as a precautionary measure to ensure safety. The ground stop remained in place for four hours before it was lifted, causing significant delays and disruptions to flights across the country. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said on Fox News Sunday that while there was no evidence of a cyberattack, officials were still investigating all possible causes, including human error or equipment failure. The recent spate of disruptions has left Americans on high alert, wondering if they are mere coincidences or part of a larger plan. A series of unfortunate events, including a cruise ship overturning in New Orleans after being struck by a tanker, has added to the sense of unease. articles.title: Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo Dies at Age 80 After Multiple Organ Failure
articles.summary: Mexico's notorious drug kingpin Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo has passed away at the age of 80 after suffering multiple organ failure, officials confirmed on Sunday.
articles.content: Mexico's notorious drug kingpin Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo has passed away at the age of 80, officials confirmed on Sunday. The news comes after multiple organ failure led to his death in hospital. Felix Gallardo was a key figure in modern Mexican drug trafficking, earning him the nickname "the boss of bosses due to his influence over the global cocaine trade. His reign as one of Mexico's most powerful cartels stretched far and wide. He had been imprisoned since 1989 but two days before his death he was transferred from prison to a hospital for treatment. Officials issued a statement confirming that Felix Gallardo died in a medical facility after suffering multiple organ failure. The Jalisco state security ministry released the information about Felix Gallardo's passing, stating that he remained under observation with guarded prognosis before ultimately succumbing to his illness on November 15. Felix Gallardo's health had been in a precarious state for several years prior to his passing. He suffered from a range of conditions that significantly impacted his daily life, including high blood pressure and diabetes. His hearing was also severely impaired due to deafness. In 2022, then-president Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador publicly acknowledged the gravity of Felix Gallardo's health situation when he described him as being in very poor health. However, a judge had previously granted him house arrest, but the transfer was delayed due to technical issues with his electronic ankle monitoring system. Felix Gallardo's involvement in organized crime stretched back decades and was deeply intertwined with his law enforcement career. Born in Sinaloa state on January 8, 1946, he rose through the ranks of both state and federal police forces before turning to a life of crime. His partnership with Rafael Caro Quintero was particularly significant, as together they united various gangs trafficking narcotics to the United States and formed the powerful Guadalajara cartel. The Guadalajara cartel's influence extended far beyond Mexico's borders as it became a model for other trafficking organizations. According to InSight Crime, this hegemonic model laid the groundwork for nearly all of today's drug trafficking activities. Felix Gallardo formed alliances with key players in the Colombian cocaine trade, including Pablo Escobar. As his most important associate in Mexico, Felix Gallardo played a crucial role in facilitating the flow of narcotics into the United States. His reputation as El jefe de jefes" and "El Padrino", meaning "the boss of bosses" and "the Godfather, was well-deserved, given the Guadalajara gang's stranglehold on Mexico's underworld. The cartel was a force to be reckoned with. Felix Gallardo faced severe consequences for his involvement in the February 1985 murder of Camarena Salazar. The agent's kidnapping and torture had sent shockwaves through law enforcement agencies, both in Mexico and the United States. The arrest of Caro Quintero in 1985 was a direct result of intense pressure from Washington. He is now serving time in prison for his role in the agent's murder and other drug trafficking charges. Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo's notorious reputation has endured through popular culture, including narcocorridos like El jefe de jefes", which is prohibited in public spaces due to its glorification of the kingpin. The Guadalajara cartel, from which the Sinaloa cartel would eventually emerge, was co-founded by Felix Gallardo, who had been behind bars since 1989. His involvement in establishing ties with Colombian traffickers was a significant factor in Mexico's drug trade landscape.
